landing.c1_h: The whole history, not just the recent part
landing.c1_p: On linking, the latest of each chat arrives. From there the app asks the phone for what came before, conversation by conversation, anchored on the oldest message it already holds. It keeps going back while there is anything left to fetch.
landing.c2_h: On your machine, in your Drive
landing.c2_p: Messages live in PostgreSQL, on your computer. The remote copy goes to your Google Drive, encrypted and inside a folder the app creates itself. There is no server in between: nobody else holds a copy.
landing.c3_p: Attachments are downloaded and checked against their cryptographic fingerprint before being accepted. They are kept next to their message, so the conversation reads whole rather than half.
landing.c4_p: Your personal WhatsApp and your work one, in the same app and in separate contexts: different chats, different history, different backup. You switch with a selector, and they are never shown together.
landing.c5_h: It keeps itself up to date
landing.c5_p: While it is open, new messages come in the moment they reach the phone. No «refresh» button, no reloading the page.
landing.c6_p: How you had your WhatsApp arranged is respected: archived ones in their section, pinned at the top, muted ones marked. Locked chats sit behind a code.
landing.end_h: O teu histórico, nas tuas mãos
landing.end_p: It installs on your machine, links in a minute, and works on its own from then on.
landing.foot_legal: Projeto independente. Não afiliado ao WhatsApp nem à Meta.
landing.h1_b: on your computer and in your Drive.
landing.l1_p: Not one. This is a backup, and a tool that can write on your behalf in your WhatsApp is a different thing with different risks.
landing.l2_b: It uploads nothing to servers of ours.
landing.l2_p: There are no «ours»: the copy goes from your machine to your Drive.
landing.l3_b: It cannot recover what your phone no longer has.
landing.l3_p: History is asked of the phone; if it was deleted there, there is nowhere to get it from.
landing.l4_b: It does not decrypt what WhatsApp will not hand over.
landing.l4_p: An attachment its server no longer serves —which happens with older ones— is marked unavailable instead of pretending it is there.
landing.lead: Link your account as one more device —just like WhatsApp Web— and this app brings over your conversations, your history and your attachments. It keeps them in a database of your own and uploads an encrypted copy to your own Google Drive.
landing.limits_h: O que não faz, e porquê
landing.pill: Cópia de segurança local · Apenas leitura
landing.problem_1: WhatsApp keeps your history on your phone. If you lose it, if you replace it, if the automatic backup fails, or if you simply want to find something from three years ago, that compressed file is not much use: it cannot be read, cannot be searched, and cannot be opened from anywhere else.
landing.problem_2: This app makes the backup differently: it connects as a linked device and asks for your history conversation by conversation, as far back as the phone still has it. What comes down stays in a database you can search, browse and open whenever you want.
landing.readonly: It does not send messages. It cannot: it is built to read and to keep.
landing.s1_p: Email and password. It stays in your installation.
landing.s2_p: With the smallest permission there is: the app only sees the files it creates itself. The rest of your Drive is invisible to it.
landing.s3_p: The same gesture as WhatsApp Web: Settings › Linked devices › Link a device.
landing.s4_p: Extraction starts on its own and runs in the background. You can close the tab and come back: it carries on where it left off.
